original_implementation.description: Locally authored spherical finite-volume HLL/Heun Euler evolution, independent of the reference eigenvalue/ODE algorithms. Physical geometry and numerical flux identities are checked separately.

reference_implementation.description: Uses actual pinned LANL ExactPack eigenvalue and similarity RHS code. Default execution reuses the hash-bound eigenvalue from the completed original shooting/qualification and freshly integrates the pre-collapse ODE; full eigenvalue shooting is an explicit regeneration operation. The critical-phase residual is freshly checked in the tests. It is not an independently reimplemented similarity ODE.

inputs_and_acceptance.policy: Original physical inputs and acceptance were fixed before the original primary execution and remain byte-identical. Revised numerical/reference sources and tests are bound before each revision execution. Earlier sources, contracts and failed public replay records are retained; presentation changes do not loosen scientific criteria.

figures: Only saved, hash-qualified radial states are mapped to a meridional plane. No plotted image is described as a Cartesian 2D calculation.
